name: io.github.thaitrevor/gold-mcp
description: MCP server for XAUUSD (gold) market data + 4-tier trading toolkit. Free tier: Yahoo Finance OHLCV + macro context, realtime PAXG ticks via Binance public WS, BYOK MT5 broker adapter. Paid tiers add advanced TA, vectorized backtest, SMC suite (order blocks, FVG, CHOCH/BOS, liquidity sweeps), Hurst regime classifier, Kelly/Monte Carlo risk, BYOK Claude AI analyst. Educational and research use only.
